Theme

Latin word

dīligenter

adverb

carefully, attentively, thoroughly

In this lexicon

  • carefully

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Eun. 207–208: At dīligenter. — Fīet.; Cic. Fam. 16.18.3: cūrā tē dīligenter

  • Audī dīligenter.: listen carefully

    classical

Examples

  • Fac ita ut jussī. — Faciam. — At dīligenter. — Fīet. — At mātūrē. — Fīet.

    Do as I told you. — I will. — Carefully, mind. — It shall be done. — And promptly. — It shall be done.Ter. Eun. 207–208

    In the entry for carefully

  • tē quandō exspectēmus fac ut sciam. cūrā tē dīligenter. valē.

    Let me know when to expect you. Take good care of yourself. Goodbye.Cic. Fam. 16.18.3
